name: key_areas
note_zh: 临时示意几何。总体设计范围与三处重点区直接采用主办方场地包 provisional_boundaries.geojson 的临时替代边界；其余图层为本方案在该边界内的概念设计建议。全部要素 official_boundary=false，不得作为法定红线、审批依据或精确面积复算依据。；三处重点区互不重叠且位于 site_boundary 内
note_en: Provisional schematic geometry. The overall design area and the three key areas reuse the organizer's provisional_boundaries.geojson polygons verbatim; all other layers are this proposal's conceptual design inside that boundary. Every feature has official_boundary=false and must not be used as a statutory redline, approval basis, or precise area source. The three key areas are non-overlapping and inside site_boundary.

properties.derivation_method: 按公告自北向南第一处、众智园AI自主创新加速区、约192.1公顷及五环路/清河相关任务线索，在临时总体设计范围内粗略定位并校核面积；公告未给出四至，矩形边不得解释为地块或道路红线。
properties.usage_note: 仅用于 AI agent 生成、展示和临时自检；不得作为 official key-area polygon、审批依据或精确面积复算依据。
